driver: An area is estimated from reference observations drawn with stratum-specific inclusion probabilities from a preliminary classification that was revised before the estimate; the revised classification's own count and the textbook estimator stratified by its classes both misweight the observations, because the oversampled observations the revision moved between classes keep the inclusion probabilities of the classes they were drawn from, and only weighting each observation by its own design weight recovers the area.
driver_concrete: The 2024-2025 reference points were drawn in January 2026 by stratified random sampling on the preliminary change map (400 in its deforestation class, 2,400 in stable forest, 1,200 in non-forest); the final map reprocessed in April with radar and late-season imagery moved 124 of the 400 preliminary-deforestation points, 21 of them real clearings, into stable forest, so an error matrix on the final map's classes weights each of them at 2,367 ha instead of the 329 its stratum gives it and states 171,600 ha, close under the reference level, while the final map's own area (73,200 ha) misses the clearings it left out; only the stratified estimator on the sampling strata, each point weighted by its stratum's area over its points, gives the 122,900 ha the emission reductions rest on.
stump: A competent analyst conforms the two interpretation campaigns correctly, builds the error matrix of the final change map against the reference points and estimates the deforested area from it with the final map's class areas as weights, the stratified estimator of good practice: 171,600 ha, 8,300 under the reference level's 179,900 for the two years, so 3,382,582 tonnes offered; the final map's own deforestation (73,200 ha) would offer 43,484,518 tonnes; only the stratified estimator on the strata the sample was drawn from, each point weighted by its preliminary stratum's area over its points, gives 122,900 ha and 23,229,780 tonnes offered for USD 116,148,900.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms both campaigns and the adjudication on the national forest definition and the reporting period and executes every article of the payment agreement assesses the final change map, the map the monitoring report presents, against the reference points and estimates the area from its error matrix with its mapped class areas: 171,600 ha and 3,382,582 tonnes offered; the final map's own area offers 43,484,518 tonnes; neither is the 23,229,780 tonnes the sample's own design gives.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the reporting period's deforested area, estimated the way forest monitoring estimates activity data for an emissions inventory: from a probability sample of reference points interpreted on high-resolution imagery, analysed by the design it was drawn under (strata from the map used for sampling, the final map only reporting where change sits), and turned into emission reductions against the reference level with the inventory's emission factor; with a hospital's nouns there is no change map, no interpreted reference point, no reference level or emission factor, and the task stops reading.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a period total of the product of two series, one recorded at every interval and one sampled on a few intervals that mostly catch the quiet state; the sampled factor rises with the recorded one, so carrying the sampled values across the unsampled intervals, by averaging or interpolating, misprices the busy intervals that carry most of the total, and the total has to be built from the relationship between the two factors applied to every recorded interval.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each tributary's water-year 2026 phosphorus load is the sum over days of discharge times concentration; concentration is sampled on the Commission's fixed rounds (the first and third Tuesdays), which fall mostly away from storms, plus a few college storm samples, and it rises with discharge, so interpolating or averaging the samples across the year prices the high-flow days at the readings of the days around them, while a rating curve of concentration on discharge, applied to every day of the gage record, prices them from the relationship.
lineage.fate: shipped 2026-10-13 (judge pass 1 FIX_NOW, re-judge DETERMINISTIC, APPROVE) and re-rooted 2026-10-14 at the author's request for a stronger stump: the decisive step (a concentration-discharge rating curve applied to every day of the gage record) is the field's standard load method, which careful solvers reach for; two second layers after shipping (season, retransformation) and two hardening prototypes (a dense automated sampler, a kinked relation) were rejected as too thin for one answer or a choice between standard practices.
